description: The top-level App Router shell wrapping pages that stays mounted across route navigations and preserves UI state.
A plain JSON-safe article data object containing primitive fields and ISO date strings safe to cross Server-to-Client boundaries.
Logic mapping URL pathnames such as '/' and '/articles/[slug]' to structured route views or a not-found fallback.
Applying a root format pattern such as '%s | Constela Press' to child article titles while preserving a default home title.
Marking the currently active navigation link with aria-current='page' so screen readers and users know their active location.
